crossRefs.note: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you…
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed…
The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”
She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember…
God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass…
Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your…
who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;
He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

people.name: Elkanah
people.line: The father of the prophet Samuel.

people.name: Hannah
people.line: The mother of the prophet Samuel.

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.
translations.bsb: The next morning they got up early to bow in worship before the LORD, and then they returned home to Ramah. And Elkanah had relations with his wife Hannah, and the LORD remembered her.
translations.kjv: And they rose up ➔ in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
translations.asv: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before Jehovah, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Jehovah remembered her.
